tip.tipsmod.torchmaster.text: Mega Torches prevent hostile mobs from spawning within a certain radius. Right-click a Mega Torch with an empty hand to display its effective area.
tip.tipsmod.create.engineers_goggles.tex: When inspecting Create machinery, Engineer's Goggles display detailed information such as stress consumption and rotational speed, making them invaluable for diagnosing overloads and other issues.
tip.tipsmod.create.rotation_speed_contro: Higher rotational speed increases machine efficiency, but also raises stress consumption. Driving a small cogwheel with a large cogwheel increases speed, while the reverse decreases it.
tip.tipsmod.create.wrench.text: The Wrench is Create's essential tool. It can adjust the orientation and configuration of most mechanical blocks. Shift + right-click or left-click allows you to quickly dismantle machine components.
tip.tipsmod.create.windmill.text: Windmills are an optional early-game power source. Place at least 8 Wool blocks or Sail Frames in front of a Windmill Bearing, glue them together with Super Glue, and right-click the bearing to start it. Output reaches its maximum of 8192 SU at 128 sails.
tip.tipsmod.create.mechanical_arm.text: Mechanical Arms are flexible logistics components. Hold a Mechanical Arm and right-click targets to configure inputs (blue) and outputs (yellow), with support for multiple connections. They operate within a spherical area of roughly 5 blocks in radius and can move up to one stack at a time.
tip.tipsmod.create.deployer.text: Deployers can simulate a player's right- or left-click actions. In Use mode, they can place blocks or feed entities automatically. In Attack mode, they can break blocks or attack entities. Applying a redstone signal pauses their operation.
tip.tipsmod.create.mechanical_saw.text: Mechanical Saws can fell entire trees and process items. When placed facing upward, a kinetic input appears on the side, allowing Block Cutting and Cutting recipes to be performed. A handheld version can also be crafted.
tip.tipsmod.create.mechanical_piston.tex: Mechanical Pistons require Piston Extension Poles behind them to move structures. Using a Sticky Mechanical Piston or attaching Slime Balls allows the structure to be retracted. Combined with contraptions, they can be used for automated farms or tunneling machines.
tip.tipsmod.create.train_signal.text: Train Signals are the core of the railway system. Holding a signal while looking at tracks displays colored lines representing different track sections. Proper signal placement divides sections and ensures safe train operation.
tip.tipsmod.create.mechanical_crafter.te: Multiple Mechanical Crafters can form a crafting array to automatically perform vanilla crafting recipes and Create-exclusive Mechanical Crafting recipes, enabling large-scale automation.
tip.tipsmod.create.bulk_processing.text: Encased Fans can perform bulk processing when combined with blocks such as Lava, Water, or Soul Sand. Depending on the catalyst used, they support Smelting, Washing, Smoking, and Haunting, making them ideal for large-scale ore processing.
tip.tipsmod.create.smart_chute.text: Smart Chutes are advanced vertical logistics components with built-in filter slots, allowing only specified items to pass through. Holding right-click lets you configure transfer limits or exact amounts per operation, and they can be enabled or disabled via redstone signals.
tip.tipsmod.create.steam_engine.text: Steam Engines are advanced mid-to-late-game power sources. They must be attached to Fluid Tanks to form a boiler and require water input and a heat source underneath. At maximum efficiency, they can generate up to 16384 SU of stress capacity.
tip.tipsmod.create.train_station.text: To assemble a train, first connect a Train Station to a track, which will create a blue marker. Then right-click the marker with a Train Casing to create a bogey, which serves as the starting point for building the train.
tip.tipsmod.create.fluid_pipe.text: Fluid Pipes require Mechanical Pumps to provide pressure for fluid transport. A single pump can move fluids up to 16 blocks by default. For longer distances, additional pumps must be placed periodically along the pipeline.
tip.tipsmod.create.stress.text: In a kinetic network, higher rotational speed increases machine performance but also raises stress consumption. If total stress demand exceeds total stress capacity, the entire system will stop operating.
tip.tipsmod.create.schematicannon.text: The Schematicannon can read schematics and automatically construct structures in the world. Supply it with gunpowder and the required materials, and it will accurately place blocks starting from the designated position.
tip.tipsmod.create.tunnel.text: Brass Tunnels are intelligent logistics components that can distribute items from a single conveyor belt to multiple outputs. Filters can be configured to assign specific item types to each channel.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.spellbook_e: Spellbooks are the primary spellcasting tool. Equip one in your main hand, off-hand, or curio slot to cast the spells stored within. Different tiers of spellbooks provide varying numbers of spell slots and unique bonuses.
Spell Scrolls can be right-clicked to cast their stored spell instantly. They consume no mana and have no cooldown, but each scroll is single-use and disappears after casting.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.inscription: The Inscription Table is the core block for managing spellbooks. Insert a spellbook and a spell scroll to permanently inscribe the scroll's spell into the book, or extract a spell from a spellbook back into a scroll.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.arcane_anvi: The Arcane Anvil is a powerful utility block. It can combine two scrolls of the same spell to increase spell level, imbue weapons with spells, and enhance equipment using Upgrade Orbs.
Staves are alternative spellcasting tools that can cast spells directly when right-clicked. Many staves provide bonuses such as spell power or mana regeneration, while advanced staves can significantly enhance specific magic schools.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.mana.text: Mana is the resource required to cast spells. Players begin with a maximum of 100 mana. Wearing certain rings, using higher-tier spellbooks, or applying Upgrade Orbs can increase the mana cap. Mana regenerates naturally over time.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.spell_power: The Spell Power attribute increases the damage, range, and effectiveness of spells by a percentage. Wearing school-specific mage armor or using Upgrade Orbs can greatly enhance the spell power of a particular magic school.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.casting_met: Spells use different casting methods. Instant spells activate immediately, charge spells require holding before release, channeled spells continuously consume mana to maintain their effect, and long-cast spells require a casting period before activation.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.alchemist_c: The Alchemist's Cauldron can recycle unwanted spell scrolls. Toss a spell scroll into a cauldron containing water for a 50% chance to recover ink of the corresponding rarity, making it an effective way to obtain ink.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.upgrade_orb: Upgrade Orbs can be used in the Arcane Anvil to enhance equipment. School-specific orbs grant matching spell power bonuses, while others increase maximum mana, reduce cooldowns, or improve spell resistance. Each upgrade stacks cumulatively.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.arcane_esse: Arcane Essence is one of the most important crafting materials in the mod. It is required for Arcane Cloth, Arcane Ingots, and a wide variety of magical equipment. Be sure to collect plenty while exploring magical structures such as Wizard Towers. It can also be obtained through simulated Ender Dragon drops.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.spellbook_c: Different spellbook tiers provide different numbers of spell slots. Higher-tier spellbooks also grant additional maximum mana and cooldown reduction.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.wizard_suit: The Wizard Armor set is an entry-level magical armor set. Wearing the full set grants a small bonus to maximum mana and spell power. It can later be upgraded at a Smithing Table into specialized mage armor for individual magic schools.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.ink_tiers.t: Ink comes in five rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary, corresponding to different spell scroll qualities. Recycling spell scrolls in an Alchemist's Cauldron has a 50% chance to return ink of the matching rarity.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.focus_mater: Different magic schools require different focus materials when creating spell scrolls. For example, the Fire school uses Blaze Rods, the Ice school uses Frozen Bones, the Holy school uses Divine Pearls, and the Nature school uses Poisonous Potatoes.
Each magic school has a corresponding resistance attribute. Wearing specific mage armor increases your defense against spells from that school. Choosing the correct resistance gear can greatly improve survivability against powerful spellcasters.
tip.tipsmod.irons_spellbooks.spell_rarit: Spell rarity ranges from Common to Legendary across five tiers and directly affects spell damage, duration, and other effects. Using an Arcane Anvil together with ink of the appropriate rarity allows spell scrolls to be upgraded to higher tiers.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.blueprint.text: Blueprints are an important prerequisite for crafting Silent Gear equipment. Each item requires its matching blueprint, and using blueprints avoids recipe conflicts with other mods.
Materials in Silent Gear have a grade. The same material can come in different grades, and higher-grade materials usually provide better attribute bonuses.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.part_system.text: Most equipment is assembled from multiple parts, such as tool heads, grips, and bindings. The materials used in each part together determine the final stats.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.traits.text: Many materials carry unique traits. Some improve mining, others enhance combat. A well-chosen combination of traits is often stronger than raw numbers alone.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.mod_kit.text: The Gear Modification Kit lets you swap out individual parts of a piece of gear without rebuilding it from scratch. Use it to upgrade old equipment after improving your materials.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.repair_kit.text: The Repair Kit quickly restores damaged gear. Repairing is usually much cheaper than crafting a new high-grade item.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.gems.text: Some gear accepts gemstones for tip upgrades. Gems grant extra attribute bonuses or special effects, making them an important path for tool enhancement.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.prospector_hammer: The Prospector's Hammer searches for nearby ore deposits. It drastically cuts down on blind mining when you're hunting for large veins.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.hammer.text: The Hammer is an area-mining tool that breaks multiple blocks at once. It is far more efficient than a pickaxe for large-scale mining.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.excavator.text: The Excavator has area-mining capability, making it perfect for quickly clearing dirt, sand, and gravel.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.saw.text: The Saw processes trees quickly and is an essential logging tool, greatly improving wood gathering during the resource-collection stage.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.material_mixing.t: You don't have to stick to a single material. Combining several materials often produces more balanced overall performance.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.salvager.text: The Salvager recovers part of the materials from gear. Before scrapping failed or outdated equipment, try salvaging it first.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.adamant.text: Materials with the Adamant trait increase armor's damage resistance, and when used in tools they deal extra damage to high-health mobs.
tip.tipsmod.silentgear.tooltip.text: Hover over a piece of gear and hold Shift and Ctrl to view material sources, trait descriptions, and more detailed item information.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.affix_item.text: Affix items are the core drops of the Apotheosis adventure system. Defeating mobs or opening chests has a chance to yield gear with affix stats, whose strength scales with the World Tier.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.world_tier.text: The World Tier determines the maximum quality of affix items and gemstones. Raising it makes enemies stronger, but also makes drops rarer and more powerful.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.affix_system.text: The affix system adds extra stats to gear, such as attack power, max health, or special abilities. Affixes can dramatically change an item's combat role.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.boss_loot.text: Apotheosis bosses drop gear with high-tier affixes, sometimes with built-in gem sockets, making them a key source of late-game equipment.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.gem_system.text: Gems can be socketed into gear slots to provide additional attribute bonuses. Different gems suit different combat styles and can be freely combined.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.gem_slots.text: Some affix items come with gem sockets, and the reforge/augment system can add even more sockets.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.reforge_table.tex: The Reforging Table rerolls an item's affixes and gem sockets, making it essential for optimizing your build.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.augment_table.tex: The Augmenting Table raises the level of existing affixes, though some fixed affixes cannot be upgraded further.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.ench_module.text: The Enchantment Module raises the enchanting cap from level 30 to higher tiers and introduces a bookshelf progression system.
The enchanting system progresses through several stages: basic, Nether/Ocean, Abyssal, and Endgame, each requiring higher-tier bookshelves.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.spawner_mod.text: Apotheosis spawners let you modify a spawner's spawn rate and mob count, and they can be picked up with Silk Touch.
tip.tipsmod.apotheosis.loot_system.text: The Apotheosis loot system generates equipment and resources of varying quality based on structure type and World Tier; higher-tier structures produce significantly better loot.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_core.text: A maid is an interactive automated assistant that can handle transport, cleaning, combat, gathering, and more.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_affection.text: Kissing a maid increases affection. At level 3 affection, some extra intimate interactions are unlocked.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_ai_mode.text: Each maid has different work modes, such as Cleaning, Combat, and Gathering. The mode determines what tasks she performs.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_inventory.text: A maid's inventory is her core storage, used to collect drops or transport resources. Combined with storage tools, it enables cross-region logistics.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_combat.text: In Combat mode, a maid actively attacks nearby hostile mobs, and weapons and trinkets can boost her survivability and damage.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_equipment.text: Maids can equip weapons, armor, and trinkets. These affect not only combat ability but also her functional behavior and support effects.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_affinity.text: The affection system affects a maid's work efficiency and interaction ability. Higher affection usually improves efficiency and response priority.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_command.text: You can manage maid behavior through the GUI, including task assignment, area settings, and priority adjustments.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_storage_link.text: The Maid Storage addon links maids with storage systems, letting them automatically organize chests and warehouses for semi-automated logistics.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_cosmetic.text: Maid appearance can be changed with resource packs, but cosmetics usually do not affect basic functions.
tip.tipsmod.tlm.maid_tool_interaction.te: Some maid tools let her perform special interactions, such as cooking, serving food, or ranged attacks.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.ore_tier.text: Geodes are widespread in the Spectrum world, and different crystal types correspond to different layers and environments.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.material_core.text: Many advanced recipes require a higher-tier Pedestal structure.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.refinement_system.t: The Refining Furnace can smelt ores for multiplied output.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.crystallization.tex: The Crystallarieum refines and duplicates various ores.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.network_system.text: The Pigment Network is a multi-node logistics system that moves items between different functional nodes.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.node_types.text: The Pigment Network includes provider, storage, sender, and connection nodes, each with a different role.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.color_energy.text: Ink energy is the core energy system of Spectrum, with different colors leaning toward different functions.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.biological_items.te: Some Spectrum plants, such as jade vines and blood orchids, have special planting requirements.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.soul_infusion.text: The Spirit Instiller converts mob heads into memories.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.synthesis_accelerat: The Synthesis Accelerator significantly speeds up crafting at the Pedestal.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.box_risk.text: Some Mysterious Boxes have dangerous effects that can cause environmental pollution or status ailments.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.ritual_system.text: The Fusion Shrine performs advanced crafting and rituals.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.ender_like_system.t: Ender Hoppers and Ender Droppers can link to Ender Chests.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.lighting_blocks.tex: You can dye Little Dragons with a paintbrush!
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.progression_curve.t: Spectrum progression is tiered rather than linear.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.me_network_core.text: The ME Network is the core structure of Applied Energistics, made up of controllers, cables, and other devices to manage items and automation.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.controller_role.text: The ME Controller is the network's core node, providing 32 channels per face and converting FE into AE. It is the foundation of complex networks.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.channels_system.text: The channel system limits how many devices can connect; planning your cable layout well is key to avoiding network failure.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.cable_types.text: Different ME cables have different capacity tiers; higher-tier cables carry more channels.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.storage_cells.text: AE storage cells store items, fluids, and chemicals, with capacity tiers determining their maximum data.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.cell_types.text: AE storage comes in item, fluid, and chemical types, each of which can be expanded independently.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.me_terminal.text: The ME Terminal gives direct access to network inventory and is the basic interface for operating an ME system.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.crafting_terminal.text: The Crafting Terminal adds on-demand crafting to the basic terminal, pulling materials from the network to craft items directly.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.pattern_system.text: The Pattern Terminal records crafting recipes and is the core mechanism behind automatic crafting.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.crafting_cpu.text: The Crafting CPU executes complex crafting jobs; its size determines processing capacity.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.auto_crafting.text: Combining an ME Requester with pattern providers enables fully automated production lines.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.storage_bus.text: The Storage Bus connects external containers to the ME network, unifying inventory management across blocks.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.import_export_bus.text: Import and export buses control item flow, but ME Interfaces generally perform better.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.interface_block.text: The ME Interface serves as both a storage node and a pattern input point, making it a key hub for automation.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.p2p_tunnel.text: P2P Tunnels transmit channels, items, or energy over long distances, greatly reducing cable usage.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.quantum_link.text: The Wireless Connector links distant ME networks, keeping them synchronized across regions.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.ender_broadcaster.text: The Ender Broadcaster uploads and downloads channels through the cloud, so you no longer need to run cables or P2P tunnels.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.energy_system.text: The ME Network depends on power; more complex networks use more energy, and insufficient power halts the network.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.security_terminal.text: The Security Terminal manages permissions, restricting access to network inventory and automation. Wireless terminals no longer need it and now connect directly to an access point.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.crafting_patterns.text: Different pattern types define crafting, processing, stonecutting, and smithing recipes, enabling highly modular production.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.accelerator_cards.text: Acceleration Cards speed up device processing at the cost of higher energy use.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.capacity_cards.text: Capacity Cards expand a device's storage but do not change its processing speed.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.redstone_control.text: Some ME devices support Redstone Cards for conditional automation logic.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.pattern_encoding.text: The Pattern Management Terminal lets you view every pattern in the network, with two upgrade paths: the extended management terminal and the encoding access terminal.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.molecular_assembler.text: The Molecular Assembler executes pattern crafting and is the final execution unit for workbench automation.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.storage_overflow.text: When storage is full, the network cannot accept new items and crafting stalls; you need to expand storage.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.crafting_failure.text: If materials are missing, autocrafting jobs wait in a pending state and can be cancelled and reissued.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.network_design.text: Good ME network planning matters more than stacking devices, and helps avoid channel congestion.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.storage_priority.text: Setting storage priority controls the order in which items are stored across containers.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.item_flow_logic.text: Item movement in ME systems follows request-driven logic rather than passive transport.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.subnet_usage.text: Subnetworks isolate functional modules or allocate pattern ingredients, preventing overload and clutter on the main network.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.wireless_access.text: The Wireless Terminal lets you access ME inventory and crafting remotely within range.
tip.tipsmod.ae2.wireless_access_key.text: Wireless terminals can be combined into a universal terminal and worn in a trinket slot; press Shift+E to open it by default.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.core_system.text: Mekanism combines ore processing, energy networks, chemical industry, and nuclear power into one highly modular industrial mod.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.ore_processing.text: Mekanism ore processing can multiply a single ore, up to 5x output!
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.digital_miner.text: The Digital Miner automatically scans for and mines ores, making it a key resource machine in the early-to-mid game.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.machine_upgrade.tex: Upgrade Modules greatly improve machine performance; the most common are speed, energy, and chemical upgrades.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.machine_upgrade_sta: Stack Upgrades significantly increase per-thread parallelism in machines above their absolute tier.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.cable_system.text: Universal Cables connect machines to the energy network, with tiers determining capacity and transfer limits.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.logistical_pipe.tex: Logistical Pipes transport items and can be filtered, split, and prioritized with a Logistical Sorter.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.pressurized_pipe.te: Pressurized Tubes transport gases and are fundamental infrastructure for the chemical industry.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.mechanical_pipe.tex: Mechanical Pipes transport fluids and handle fluid routing in industrial chains.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.infusion_system.tex: The Metallurgic Infuser is the key machine for producing Mekanism alloys.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.crushing.text: The Crusher performs basic material crushing and is compatible with several mods.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.electrolytic_separa: The Electrolytic Separator splits water into hydrogen and oxygen, the starting point of the gas industry.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.chemical_oxidizer.t: The Chemical Oxidizer converts materials into gases and is very useful in AE autocrafting, avoiding infusion item ratios.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.solar_system.text: Melon Fusion is a stable early power source, but a fully self-sustaining melon fusion setup is not simple!
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.fusion_reactor.text: The Fusion Reactor runs on deuterium and tritium, generating enormous power with no pollution or risk!
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.fission_reactor.tex: The Fission Reactor provides extremely high energy output and material production but must be kept stable.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.radiation_system.te: Radiation continuously affects players and the environment, requiring protective gear or shielding units.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.mekasuit.text: The MekaSuit is Mekanism's ultimate armor, offering flight, shields, and negative-effect cleansing.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.tool_system.text: MekaTools expand their functions with modules, covering everything from mining to combat.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.jetpack.text: The Jetpack provides flight, powered by hydrogen.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.qio_system.text: The QIO System is an advanced storage system supporting large-scale item storage.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.qio_network.text: The QIO Network builds cross-dimensional storage through drive arrays and input/output ports.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.reactor_control.tex: The Fission Reactor requires precise fuel and coolant control, or it may spiral out of control.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.automation_logic.te: Mekanism's core is the full industrial automation chain, not the performance of any single machine.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.item_filter.text: The Logistical Sorter controls the input/output behavior of logistical pipes and machines.
tip.tipsmod.mekanism.round_robin.text: Logistical Pipes default to nearest-first routing, which can hurt throughput.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.wand_basics.text: An Iron-capped Wooden Wand stores at most 25 vis of each aspect, with an average vis cost of 110%—it consumes 10% more aspects than EMI shows. Aspect orbs dropped by mobs or from Source Mushrooms can recharge it.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.research_table.te: Place two tables side by side and right-click with Scribing Tools to form a Research Table. When copying research from the Thaumonomicon, GoldenTweaks automatically uses Scribing Tools on research tables within 5x5x5, but you still need Paper in your inventory.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.scanning.text: Hold right-click with the Thaumometer (sneaking is recommended) to scan blocks, items, and mobs for aspect knowledge. A new aspect can only be discovered when all of its component aspects are already known.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.aspect_page.text: GoldenTweaks rewrote the Thaumonomicon's aspect detail page: aspects are sorted by tier, and hovering an icon shows scanned items containing that aspect, sorted by amount in descending order.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.magic_transformat: Right-click bookshelves, tables, or cauldrons with a wand to transform them into Thaumcraft blocks. The Arcane Workbench is also the workstation of the Thaumaturge villager.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.revealing_goggles: Goggles of Revealing can be equipped in a trinket slot, granting permanent Aura Vision and Night Vision. If you're short on helmets, you can also craft the Revealing Helmet.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.cauldron.text: Sneak right-clicking with an empty hand empties the Crucible of water and essentia, but releases a large amount of flux. Walling in the crucible to make a flux-free crucible avoids this.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.distillation.text: Stack an Essentia Distiller on top of an Alchemical Furnace to form a distillation tower, then right-click the distiller with an Essentia Jar to extract essentia. GoldenTweaks lets the furnace accept inputs from the side and fuel from the bottom for automation.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.infusion_altar.te: During infusion, place infusion stabilizers (such as Tallow Candles) and central items in a centrally symmetric pattern to significantly reduce instability; dangerous infusions may need a 13x13 candle array.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.charging_node.tex: Place a node with high-tier aspects on a Node Stabilizer, put a Node Transducer above it, and apply a redstone signal to convert it into a Charged Node that recharges wands on an Arcane Workbench. Breaking the stabilizer or transducer causes an explosion.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.brain_in_jar.text: After scanning a Zombie Brain to unlock the Brain in a Jar research and completing the research on the Gold Modification page, the Brain in a Jar can consume experience to automatically solve research notes.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.warp_levels.text: Once your Warp (permanent + sticky) exceeds 25, you may unlock Eldritch at random times; above 50, you may unlock the Eldritch Revelation. The higher your Warp, the more vicious the side effects.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.warp_bath.text: Throw Purifying Bath Salts into water to create Purifying Water; bathing in it grants Warp Ward. The higher your Warp, the shorter the ward lasts.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.outer_lands.text: Place 4 Eldritch Eyes on the keystone beneath an Eldritch Obelisk and right-click with a wand, spending 100 vis of each type to open an Outer Lands portal. Hugging the left wall makes it easier to find tablets and the boss room.
The Infusion Enchanting Table allows choosing enchantments and supports vanilla, Thaumcraft, and Spectrum enchantments. It requires 6 two-block-tall Obsidian Totem pillars, each topped with a Nitor, and its infusion is very dangerous.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.essentia_relay.te: The Essentia Relay Interface uses only 1 channel: place a Vis Relay above it, sneak-right-click the interface with a Memory Card, then right-click the Arcane Crafting Terminal to supply vis to the wand inside.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.essentia_provider: Attach an Essentia Provider to the input of a Thaumic Alchemy Tower or beneath an Infusion Interceptor to automatically draw essentia from the AE network. Do not craft the Infusion Observer in the current version—it may crash the server.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.corrupt_tree.text: Tainted Trees do not spread taint; instead they resist it, making them a renewable source of Vitium essentia. They can also be planted with a Planter.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.arcane_restorer.t: The Arcane Restorer consumes Instrumentum essentia to repair items. It can repair almost anything, making it ideal for gear that cannot take Mending.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.primordial_shards: There are 6 types of Primordial Shards, dropped by mining Infused Stone underground and affected by Fortune. Demand is high, so keep a stack of each.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.wand_upgrade.text: After unlocking infusion, combine a Thaumium Wand Cap with a Silverwood Rod to upgrade your wand to 100 vis capacity. You'll also need Goggles of Revealing, Thaumaturge's Robes, and Thaumaturge's Leggings for enough vis discount.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.core_inlay.text: Place a Vis Relay on the Core Inlay Table and insert a wand core to spend experience and augment it; the required vis is supplied by a connected Charged Node.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.golem_alchemy.tex: Give a golem an Alchemy Core to move essentia; higher strength means more essentia per trip. GoldenTweaks lets it work without pathfinding—just bind the golem to the distiller's output side.
The Infernal Furnace automatically smelts ores and meat without fuel and often yields extra output, but it requires a Greatwood Wand to activate. Products eject from the front, so a Hungry Chest is handy.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.alchemy_tower.tex: The Thaumic Alchemy Tower automates common alchemy recipes (such as Balanced Shards and Thaumium Ingots) and outputs products from the front. It needs at least a Greatwood Wand to provide enough vis.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.custom_node.text: Node Mechanics lets you build custom nodes: combine a Node Matrix with 1-8 filled Aspect Ampoules in an Arcane Workbench, then infuse it with 2 World Salt. Each point of aspect costs 150 essentia and becomes 15 points of node aspect.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.node_control.text: The Node Connector safely performs node eating, while the Node Manipulator adjusts node attributes—but you must craft the matching Manipulator Core first.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.super_chanting.te: In this pack, the Super Enchanting Table uses Incantatio essentia and doubles enchantment levels. Burn Enchanted Fabric to obtain Incantatio essentia.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.animated_workbenc: The Animated Workbench works like a Deployer but consumes no stress. Right-click to open its configuration and enable redstone control.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.defense_charm.tex: After sneak-right-clicking to activate, the Defense Charm can be equipped in the amulet slot and automatically clears negative effects—even stubborn Void Warp effects.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.super_glow.text: Carrying a Super Nitor automatically lights your surroundings and leaves a long trail of light behind you at night.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.magic_crops.text: Thaumic Bases magic seeds efficiently renew various resources, and GoldenTweaks adds right-click harvesting support. Some plants ignore Bone Meal and Grow Lamps, but Fertilizer works on them.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.rose_seed.text: Thaumic Rose Seeds produce Knowledge Fragments containing Primordial and Vitium aspects (place the matching crystal block beneath the soil). The Vis Orbs dropped by Source Mushrooms are the most practical early way to recharge a wand.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.echo_metal.text: Mystic Crystal Ingots are a stronger and harder-to-make magic metal than Thaumium, and also an excellent hard-metal material.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.ancient_blocks.te: Eldritch Arks, Old-Style Bricks, Quicksilver Blocks, and other ancient blocks (including their slab versions) provide a small amount of infusion stability and can replace some candles.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.tainted_metal.tex: Shadow Metal surpasses Thaumium and Void Metal in performance and durability. It can upgrade Void Armor and is also a Silent Gear material.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.blood_dagger.text: Attacking enemies with the Bloodletting Dagger automatically fills Glass Ampoules in your inventory, producing Bottled Bloody Blood. It is used to craft Bloody Cloth and Void Crystals that give armor self-repair.
The Astrolabe, Celestial Lens, Lunar Phase Meter, and Star Chart must be placed above 100 blocks, directly facing the sky. GoldenTweaks simplified interaction—right-click with a Catalyst to collect products directly.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.healing_vat.text: Supplying essentia to the Healing Vat heals creatures: Victus restores health, Sano rapidly heals and clears negative effects, Fames restores hunger, and Mortuus/Exanimis heal undead.
tip.tipsmod.thaumcraft.essence_disk.text: Point an Import/Export Bus holding an Essentia Access Card at an Essentia Jar to input or output essentia; essentia in the network can be stored centrally with Storage Disks.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.cmy_gems.text: Amethyst generates underground, Citrine in rivers and lakes, and Topaz on high mountains. Gather all three gems to begin your Spectrum journey.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.onyx_fusion.text: Place a bucket of lava and one stack of each of the three gems into the Fusion Shrine. Onyx only forms during the brief window at midnight of a new moon, so park a Magnet-upgraded bucket nearby and collect it once the progress ticks over.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.sapling_pigments.te: Breaking colored leaves yields pigments, with Fortune increasing the amount. Early on you can craft all 11 colored saplings; a Planter or Pigment Extractor plus a Crushing Wheel automates pigment production.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.pigment_extractor.t: Insert a sapling into the Pigment Extractor and feed fertilizer from the side to rapidly produce pigments, extracted from the bottom. Vegetal Essence is stronger than bone meal and has a small chance to return extra saplings.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.decoheres.text: Place Decohering Microbes on leaves and wait; the leaves rot and can be mined for Vegetal Essence. Collecting rotted leaves with a glass bottle yields extra microbes. Microbes never spread inside claims.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.midnight_solution.t: Run Midnight Solution experiments far from home on a large glass platform—never in the air or over the sea. Get the products into your inventory quickly before they degrade; the solution also kills mobs for Midnight Fragments.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.jade_vine.text: Revive a Jade Vine Bulb at the Spirit Instiller and plant it on wooden fences three blocks above the ground: it only grows in moonlight and withers in sunlight. On a full-moon night, collect a mature vine with a glass bottle for Shimmerdew.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.blood_orchid.text: Revive a Blood Orchid at the Spirit Instiller and plant it on soil to harvest petals repeatedly. Tossing any flower into Liquid Crystal also yields a Resonant Lily, and they can be found beneath Bedrock too.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.little_dragon.text: Place a Baby Dragon Memory on a Blazing Crystal to hatch a baby dragon, then tame it with Jade Vine or Emerald Lotus petals. Tamed dragons can be ridden and glide; drop a Dragon Quill into Liquid Crystal for Rough Bloodstone.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.bismuth.text: Find a Bismuth Cluster on cave walls, mine it with a Silk Touch pickaxe, and place it on a metal block to cultivate—growth consumes the metal. Fully grown bismuth lets you craft the Crystallizer and grow more.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.crystallizer.text: The Crystallizer accepts seeds and catalysts from above and ink from a Pigment Network ink node. The seed only grows while both catalyst and ink last; running out of either pauses growth. In this pack it runs at 10x speed.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.malachite.text: Malachite ore occasionally appears beneath Bedrock, but it is mainly grown in the Crystallizer. This pack unifies its catalyst and growth time with the other materials of the same tier.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.liquid_crystal.text: Liquid Crystal is easily made at the Potion Workshop. Mixing it with a water or lava source produces surprising results, and you can fish in it for Spectrum-exclusive fish.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.storm_stone.text: During thunderstorms, lightning striking a Lightning Rod creates Storm Stones around it. Set rods up on your roof or a 3x3 tank ahead of time; Storm Stones can later summon another thunderstorm.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.meteorite.text: At night meteors occasionally land near your base with a thump and a particle trail. Left-click to crack one open, or Shift+right-click to pick it up; crushing it in an anvil yields more Meteorite Shards.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.knowledge_gem.text: The Black Hole Box collects items and experience orbs at once and stores the experience in a Knowledge Gem; it also supports filtering. Knowledge Gems hold large amounts of XP (more when enchanted) and power the Enchanting Pedestal.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.enchanting_pedestal: The Enchanting Pedestal lets you choose enchantments, including Spectrum-exclusive ones that unlock as you progress. Submitting Rainbow Fragments unlocks conflicting and over-limit enchantments.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.canvas.text: Right-click a tool with the Enchantment Canvas to extract its enchantments, then right-click the same kind of tool to apply them—ideal for cheap gear like the Multi-Tool. Crafting it requires Phantom Membranes.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.picker.text: The Pigment Picker converts pigments into ink, extracted with an Ink Bottle. The Crystallizer now requires a Pigment Network ink node linking a Picker to it—ink bottles can no longer be inserted directly.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.bedrock_below.text: Corrode the bedrock at the bottom of the Overworld with a Vile Erosion Bottle to open the way to Bedrock Below. The new dimension has fresh geodes and Moonstone; your eyes may need a moment to adjust to the dark.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.nightdew_bud.text: Harvesting Nightdew Sprouts has an extremely low chance to drop a Nightdew Bud; the more creatures sleeping nearby, the higher the chance, so players usually keep foxes around.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.purple_sugarcane.te: Purple Sugarcane grows in swamps such as mangrove swamps and must be planted underwater; its growth consumes nearby clay. A Planter can automate it.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.ender_effulgence.te: Kill an Enderman holding Ender Effulgence to obtain it; Endermen sometimes place it on the ground, and an out-of-place cobblestone block may be it. It is used to craft items such as the Sharing Obelisk.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.ruins_puzzle.text: Colored Ruins generate underground in the Overworld and can be found with a compass. Right-click the matching six gem powders into the item pedestals beneath the spore blossoms to open the gate; the chests inside also contain Amaranth.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.potion_workshop.tex: The Potion Workshop conveniently makes Spectrum fluids and potions, accepting input from above and output below. Catalysts alter potion properties, and completing its little challenges unlocks extra catalyst slots.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.crimson_floating.te: Crimson Floating Blocks fall like sand, and Shift+right-click picks a floating block out of the air. They can substitute for an anvil, albeit inefficiently; Familiarists need them for Crimson-tier augments.
Verdigris Fragments are found around the End outer islands. Unlike Crimson Fragments they are anti-gravity, so carrying too many may lift you off the ground. They can also be made by Sequential Assembly.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.floating_block.text: Slam a Verdigris Block into a Crimson Block to obtain a Floating Block, which lets you build a simple flying machine. Familiarists need it for Amethyst-tier augments; a Shaping Panel or Block Placer can automate it.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.dragon_bone.text: In the Dragon Rot Swamp, blast the giant bone blocks apart with Incandescent Compound and mine them with a Netherite pickaxe or better to get Dragon Bone Fragments; skeletons killed by explosions also drop them.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.humming_stone.text: Place ten or more Humming Stone blocks together and strike them in sequence; they shatter and drop Humming Stone Shards.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.deepstone_shard.tex: Deepstone Shards are obtained from mining sites beneath Bedrock and are used in late-game items; they can be duplicated with Reinforced Deepslate.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.bedrock_anvil.text: The Bedrock Anvil has no repair penalty, and GoldenTweaks adds hidden-enchant swapping: combine an Emerald Petal with an item on the anvil to switch its enchantments.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.luck_candy.text: Star Candy comes out in different colors based on your luck: negative luck favors Bittersweet Candy, zero luck favors Mellow Candy, and higher luck makes Shining, Enchanted, and Gorgeous Candy more likely.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.brewing_barrel.text: The Keg brews drinks: add items and liquid, seal it with colored planks, and wait real time before opening. Adding extra ingredients or extending the brew increases alcohol content.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.azurite.text: Azurite clusters only generate in layers near bedrock; standing above one shows blue particles rising. They are very rare, and can later be duplicated in the Crystallarieum.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.azure_shield.text: The Azure Shield works like Thaumcraft's Runic Shielding and absorbs part of incoming damage. It is required to enter the second ruin, the Azure Forcefield Ruins; remember to take the bulb and Liquid Crystal at the end.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.cleanser.text: The Cleansing Flask cleans up disasters caused by overgrown Microbes, and also works on Dark Matter from Midnight Solution and Sculk blocks, turning corroded blocks back into dirt.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.midnight_fragment.t: Mobs killed by Midnight Solution drop Midnight Fragments. When using it to kill mobs in a farm, make sure the solution cannot touch anything else; the Potion Workshop can also make it cheaply.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.multi_tool.text: The Multi-Tool combines a pickaxe, shovel, and axe in one cheap package available very early. Pair it with the Enchantment Canvas to transfer enchantments, so replacing it costs you nothing.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.lava_fishing.text: The Molten Fishing Rod lets you fish in lava, and also in Liquid Crystal or Slurry. Besides items, you can sometimes reel in living creatures.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.mother_rock.text: Mother Rocks grow their matching crystal clusters: amethyst, topaz, and citrine mother rocks come from Overworld geodes, moonstone comes from Bedrock Below geodes, and onyx is made at the Spirit Instiller. A Crushing Wheel processes the clusters automatically.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.onyx_pedestal.text: Once you have Onyx, use it to upgrade your Pedestal and its multiblock structure, unlocking higher-tier crafting.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.mermaid_gem.text: Mermaid Gem plants grow in the deep sea and spit out a small gem when mature, so you may spot one floating while sailing. A Magnet-upgraded bucket can collect them automatically.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.clover.text: Clover generates on plains, and APT can craft a Four-Leaf Clover. Planting clover with a Planter also has a tiny chance to produce one.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.sparkstone.text: Sparkstone can be found at any height and can also be crafted; mixing iron ore with torches in a basin automates production.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.ancient_plants.text: Ancient plants come from Sniffer digging: Nightdew Sprouts can be planted like weeping vines, while the Butterwood Branch is a sapling. Collect the Butter from Butterwood trees promptly to avoid item buildup.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.jade_crossbreed.tex: Crossbreed two bulbs at the Spirit Instiller to obtain new Jade Vine varieties; EMI's recipe tree can reveal the secret recipes directly.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.ominous_sapling.tex: The Ominous Sapling is unfinished and will not grow. You can submit it to exchange for some of the wood it was meant to become.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.tea_recipes.text: Submit various teas to exchange for recipes, which can also be found in the Underground City; brewing with milk produces different flavors.
Pre-enchanted tools come with useful enchantments such as Looting and Fortune at a low price—perfect for players who have terrible luck rolling their own.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.bedrock_suit.text: Bedrock armor is powerful, incredibly tough, and has infinite durability, making it a worthy late-game goal in Spectrum.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.moonstone_core.text: The Seed Vault in the Underground City is built from Protective Stone and guarded by Sentry Turrets; kill the turrets for a Moonstone Core, or craft one yourself.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.underground_city.te: The Underground City is a large structure beneath Bedrock. Its church holds the original Chiseled Moonstone Rock, while the Seed Vault contains Incandescent Compound and maps.
The Moonstone Pedestal is the fully realized Pedestal. You must find the original Chiseled Moonstone Rock in the Underground City's church to complete the structure, after which you can craft the block yourself.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.knowledge_sharing.t: Right-click with the Knowledge Sharing item to record your research, then hand it to a friend and have them right-click to share it. The Fusion Shrine can also synchronize knowledge natively.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.forest_manor.text: The Forest Manor generates beneath Bedrock and has three complex floors. Find its map in a Seed Vault or use a compass; it yields powerful gear such as the Ether Blessing Dew Gloves.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.abandoned_cathedral: Embed a Moonstone Core into the Mysterious Amulet to craft a compass leading to the Abandoned Cathedral. The author hasn't finished it yet, but completing the quest still grants a reward.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.stardust.text: Meteorite Shards can be duplicated with a Nether Star for mass consumption, and Stardust can be further processed into Micro Stardust—don't forget this production line.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.pigment_reserve.tex: All 16 colored saplings become craftable in the late game, so keep your pigment reserves full. White pigment requires a white sapling made from Moonstone.
tip.tipsmod.spectrum.overcharged_ore.tex: Overcharged Ore generates in the Nether. Mining it has a small chance to drop a complete gem, and it can also be made via Sequential Assembly. It carries heavy gravity magic, so carrying too much prevents jumping—keep it in your backpack.
